Overview of Reported Directives

According to material attributed to Iranian state reporting, Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei has reportedly issued new strategic directives to senior military commanders in Tehran. The reported instructions outline preparations for potential confrontations involving the United States and Israel, emphasizing readiness and an expanded operational scope.

Independent verification of the exact timing, authenticity, and full text of the reported orders remains limited at this stage.

Key Reported Measures

Based on the supplied material, the reported directives include the following measures:

  • Unrestricted Retaliation: Commanders were reportedly instructed to respond to threats without geographic limitations on retaliation.
  • Asset Database Updates: The military was directed to update targeting databases to encompass both physical and nonphysical U.S. and Israeli assets.
  • Conflict Termination Terms: The reported guidance asserts that if Iran faces renewed military action or attacks, Tehran should determine the timing and conditions under which hostilities cease.
  • Readiness and Mobilization: The instructions call for maximum combat readiness, enhanced intelligence capabilities, accelerated defense technology development, increased military production, nationwide mobilization, and deeper coordination with regional allies.

Practical Implications and Verification

While official statements from Iranian state media outline these preparations for a potentially wider conflict, international observers note that such announcements are often part of deterrence signaling.

To verify the original announcements and assess ongoing developments, readers should consult:

  • Official releases and broadcasts from Iranian state media agencies.
  • Statements and briefings from international defense analysts and intelligence monitors.
  • Updates from foreign policy research institutes tracking Middle Eastern security dynamics.
